Question: Assalamualaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa barakatuh 1. Is it permissible to buy foreign curency in credit? 2. What is the masnoon dua of supplicating after burial, should the imam supplicate audibly with hand raised facing the qiblah or any other directions or should every one make dua silently on their own without lifting the hands in any direction? Jazakumullah Wassalam Answer ID: 3241 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 456/340=H) One can take foreign currency in debt; there is no wrong in doing so, but the debt should be paid by the same foreign currency. (2) It is sunnah to recite first five verses of Surah Baqrah at the head of the dead and to recite last three verses of Surah Baqrah at his/her leg. It is also sunnah to pray for the dead with face towards ka?ba silently (not loudly) without raising hands. And, at places where there is no fear of misconception it is allowable to raise hands during praying. For details see: Fatawa Mahmoodiah: 14/307-309. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
